issue.title: Glossary strands agent-data-deck, llm-calls, and tool-run predate the shipped ToolRun TUI surfaces (⚒ Runs card, chips, Admin Tools tab)
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1bt.13 (docs phase of epic sase-1bt), PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1; triaged by sase-1bt.land. The epic plan forbade memory edits, so the ready-to-apply text was recorded instead. The ToolRun TUI surfaces have now shipped (row/header chips, Tools deck ⚒ Runs card, Admin Center Tools tab 7), and these strands are stale as of master 916156f887:

1. `glossary/agent-data-deck.md`: change "Tools (the LLM Calls card)" to "Tools (the ⚒ Runs card first, then LLM Calls)".
2. `glossary/llm-calls.md`: replace "named SASE tools and future ToolRuns are separate control-plane concepts" with "ToolRuns surface on the sibling ⚒ Runs card, which LLM Calls rows link to (verdict suffix + jump) instead of copying".
3. `glossary/tool-run.md`: append "In the TUI a run surfaces as a live-only ⚒ row chip on its owner node, a header chip plus Tool runs field on the selection, a ⚒ Runs block (waterfall, triage, log tail) on the Tools deck, and project-wide in Admin Center Tools (tab 7); the TUI never reconciles."
4. Optional new strand `glossary/verdict-bucket.md` (Verdict Bucket): "Bucket is the core-computed ToolRun outcome word (running, pass, new_failures, known_only, undetermined, stopped, killed, lost) rendered as glyph+word+color on every surface; silent is TUI-derived (no sample for 60s), never a core state." Prefer folding this into `glossary/triage-verdict.md` or `glossary/tool-run.md` over a new strand if that keeps the glossary smaller.

Run `sase memory init` after editing. Closing requires explicit user permission.
